::: {.home-intro}
I am an economist in the Infrastructure and Energy Sector of the Inter-American Development Bank. I received my PhD in Economics from Brown University.

My research is in development economics, with a focus on Latin America. I study how institutions and infrastructure shape economic development. My current work examines how institutions affect the allocation of water among competing users, how drought affects electricity supply, prices, and reliability in hydropower-dependent systems, and how transportation infrastructure, trade, and land reform affect structural transformation and regional development in the long run.
